# OpenCode v1 transcript provenance

`idle.jsonl` and `queued.jsonl` are redacted copies of user `part` rows in
`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`, SQLite rowids 5351 and 5352. Both parent
`message.data` records have `role: user`. The fixture keeps each actual marker
and `part.data` record shape; session IDs and surrounding message text are
removed.
